prose: Reuters reports, according to Techmeme, that the FBI attributes more than $400 million in cryptocurrency theft over 18 months to North Korean hackers using fake video calls and AI deepfakes in a scheme called FaceStealer. The original article was inaccessible. This is an attributed account of a campaign, not evidence that the user encountered it.
highlights: Feed attributes campaign findings to the FBI
Fake calls and deepfakes are the stated lure
basis: Techmeme headline and excerpt; Reuters fetch failed.
